description: List canvas dataframes (df_<id>) materialized by eia_query_route calls that passed stage: true, with provenance, expiry, row count, and column schema. Nothing is staged until such a call runs, so an empty list on a fresh session means no query has staged yet, not that staging failed. Drops entries for dataframes the canvas no longer holds before responding, so the list is always current. Pass a specific name to inspect one dataframe; omit to list all active dataframes for this tenant. A name that is not staged comes back as found=false alongside the handles that are, never as an empty list. Listing is not use: only an eia_dataframe_query statement naming a dataframe extends its expiry, so a dataframe polled with this tool and never queried still lapses on schedule.

name.description: df_<id> handle to describe a single dataframe. Omit to list all active dataframes.

name: eia_dataframe_describe

active_names.description: Every df_<id> handle staged for this tenant, regardless of the requested scope. On a miss these are the handles that are still usable.

dataframes.description: Dataframes matching the requested scope, newest first. Empty when nothing is staged, or when a supplied name does not resolve — read found and active_names to tell those apart.

column_schema.description: Column schema (all EIA data columns are VARCHAR and nullable).

items.description: A column in the dataframe schema.

type.description: DuckDB column type (VARCHAR for EIA data values).

expires_at.description: ISO 8601 expiry, extended each time an eia_dataframe_query statement references this dataframe. Reading it here does not extend it. Absent when the dataframe carries no expiry of its own and follows the canvas lifecycle.

max_rows.description: Materialization cap that produced truncated, when applicable.

query_params.description: Input parameters the source tool was called with.

truncated.description: True when the EIA upstream had more rows than were registered.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `canvas_unavailable`: DataCanvas service is not configured for this deployment. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

found.description: True when the requested name is staged, false when it is not. Absent when no name was supplied — an unscoped list has nothing to resolve.

requested_name.description: Echo of the name input. Absent when no name was supplied.

title: Describe EIA Dataframes
